digest.component_or_area: close command and ticket state reducer
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close whose completion-signature append failed from one closed with the gate disabled, because gate state is read and discarded at close time, collapsing multiple states into one

completion_expectation enum (8 values: required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be recorded durable on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, so gate-state provenance is observable by later readers

completion_expectation is computed by _completion_precheck as the second element of a returned pair, consuming the tri-state GateState with gate-state resolution precedence (force_bypassed only when gate ENABLED and --force applied; forced closes under disabled/unreadable config record gate_off/gate_unreadable)
not_applicable is set explicitly on the idea->closed transition path in close_ticket, since that path bypasses _completion_precheck entirely

completion_expectation is folded on the winning *->closed edge by _fold_close_metadata and declared present-only in reduced state (ticket_state.schema.json and types.py), backward-compatible with historical close events lacking the field

the expectation is independent of verified_result and must distinguish all eight provenance reasons including gate_unreadable (fault, not policy choice) separate from gate_off (policy choice) and disposition closes separate from required passes
